findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: Attacker sends a payload that mimics a command
findings.assumptions: The buffer content might be used later in the program to construct and execute a command. This assumption is speculative without further context.

findings.title: Buffer Overflow
findings.trigger: Attacker sends more data than the buffer can hold (1024 bytes)
findings.assumptions: The buffer is directly used without any checks on its content size. There might be subsequent code that processes the buffer without bounds checking.

findings.title: Improper Input Validation
findings.trigger: Attacker sends unexpected or malicious data
findings.assumptions: The buffer content might be used in subsequent operations that assume valid or expected data. There is no validation of the received data.
